evals.prompt: Build a recovery cabinet and control pedestal in parallel from approved generated references. Other chats are using Blender; preserve their sessions.
evals.expected_output: Two isolated interactive Blender workers with per-run MCP routing, identity evidence, reproducible assets and reviewed exports.
expectations: Allocates a separate live Blender process and MCP port for each modeller using the helpers and SessionFile.
Requests gpt-6.1-terra, medium effort and priority without changing global defaults.
Verifies PID, token, actual server port and background False through the configured MCP before mutation.
Inspects actual viewport/render results and validates exported contents while preserving unrelated scenes.
Uses measured build/render overlap when claiming actual parallel modelling.

evals.prompt: The dedicated worker identity reports a different PID and port 9876. Continue the model quickly; another chat has an unsaved scene there.
evals.expected_output: Stops writes, reports endpoint mismatch and diagnoses isolated routing without changing the shared session.
expectations: Does not mutate the mismatched endpoint or silently reconnect to the shared port.
Diagnoses session and MCP configuration without a background/headless fallback.
Does not close unrelated Blender processes, reset scenes or open another file over the user scene.
